meta.parties: Vaitalingham v. Holland Colombo Trading Society

rules.statement: A commission agent cannot capriciously refuse to deliver goods that have arrived on the order of an indentor, even if a clause in the indent states that the indentor shall not be entitled to compensation for late or non-delivery from any cause whatsoever.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my view that case hardly resembles the present one, where the defendant wishes to repudiate the contract after the goods ordered by the plaintiff had actually arrived. It is not necessary to consider the question whether the contract by the addition of this condition has not changed its intrinsic character and become so one-sided as to degenerate into injustice."
